import re


def slugify(title):
    slug = title.lower()
    slug = slug.replace("&", " and ")
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9 -]", "", slug)
    slug = re.sub(r"[ -]+", "-", slug)
    slug = slug.strip("-")
    if len(slug) > 40:
        slug = slug[:40].rstrip("-")
    return slug
